newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - BARLOWS, CIC HEAVILY TRADED.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - BARLOWS, CIC HEAVILY TRADED.

text.p: Barlows and CIC
Holdings were the most actively traded shares on the
Namibian Stock Exchange last week, accounting for two-thirds of
total turnover in the week.
Some 70,000 Barlows shares worth N$3.4 million traded in the
week, while 836,268 CIC shares worth N$2.5 million also changed
hands.
The two shares settled at N$47.85 and N$3.07 respectively on
Friday.
Total volumes on the exchange during the week were pegged at
1.36 million shares worth N$8.2 million, compared with the
151,200 shares worth N$6.2 million traded in the previous week.
Elsewhere, Namibia Breweries ended the week at
N$3.45, up from N$3.25, while Sentra Namibia moved up
5 cents to a new high of N$5.15.
The NSE Overall Index closed the week at 257.57 from to
247.43 at the end of the previous week, while the NSE Local
Index ended the week at 168.14, up from the previous close of
The exchange also recorded its first trade in government
debt when a total of N$1 million was traded in the G991 -- the
two-year 12 percent government stock.
